subject: Request: short customer clips & permission for one-pagers
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: 1-2 sentence wins + logo permission from FastPay by Tue

Hi team,

We need a couple of short customer references from FastPay to include in next week’s sales one-pager and a 2-slide customer spotlight for the August enterprise deck. Goal: 1–2 punchy quotes + one logo (with usage permission). 

Ask: can someone (Marissa / Connor) pull a quick 1–2 sentence customer quote that highlights latency/cost savings and provide a contact at FastPay who can sign off on logo/quote use? If we can get permission by EOD Tue (8/25) we’ll get this into the deck for the Wednesday sales sync.

Please include:
- Short quote (1–2 sentences) we can place on a one-pager and slide
- 1–2 metric bullets we can display (if cleared) — e.g., % cost savings, latency reduction
- Any constraints (don’t publish ARR or contract values without approval)

I’m attaching a one-pager template (stub) and a consent form we’ll send to the customer once we have the quote.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-onepager-template.pdf (stub)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quick: 1-2 sentence wins + logo permission from FastPay by Tue

Vivek —

Copy below is pulled from my recent calls with Olivia at FastPay. I can reach out today to request written sign-off and logo. Attaching a draft one-pager and the consent doc (stubs).

Suggested quote (edited for length):
"Redwood reduced our inference latency and lowered per-token cost, letting us move real-time workflows to production without compromising SLA." — Olivia Chen, Head of ML, FastPay

Suggested metric bullets (approve with customer):
- 3x reduction in median tail latency (p95) on core payment routing model
- Estimated 45% reduction in inference cost per transaction after batching + prefix cache

Notes: Olivia said she’s comfortable with a short quote and logo usage; she needs an email with the exact text we plan to publish. She asked that we avoid publishing raw revenue numbers.

Attachments: fastpay-onepager-draft.pdf, consent-form-fastpay.docx

I’ll reach out to Olivia this afternoon and request the signed consent + logo PNG.

—Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[attachment: fastpay-onepager-draft.pdf (stub), consent-form-fastpay.docx (stub)]

Marissa —

Thanks for sending the draft. FastPay is happy to provide the short quote and logo for Redwood to use in marketing and sales materials. Minor tweak to the quote below (emphasis added):

"Redwood helped us cut inference latency and reduce per-transaction cost, enabling real-time payment routing at scale without sacrificing accuracy."

We are signing the consent form and attaching a high-resolution logo. Please do not include any specific ARR or contract values; high-level percentage improvements above are OK to show.

Attached: signed-consent-fastpay.pdf (stub), fastpay-logo-approval.png (stub)

Best,
Olivia Chen

FastPay
